scripts.dev: npm run build -w @nazemni/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @nazemni/api" "npm run dev -w @nazemni/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nazemni/shared && npm run build -w @nazemni/api && npm run build -w @nazemni/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @nazemni/shared && npm run typecheck -w @nazemni/api && npm run typecheck -w @nazemni/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @nazemni/shared && npm run test -w @nazemni/shared && npm run test -w @nazemni/api
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w @nazemni/shared && npm run db:seed -w @nazemni/api
